Taean Solhyanggi-gil: coastal pine trail: Solhyanggi-gil Course 1, Iwon-myeon, Taean-gun, South Chungcheong

Most hidden-gem trekking courses cannot be reached by public transport. We recommend renting a car. This trail follows the cliffs and pine forest of the Taean coast – narrow paths, wooden steps and small beaches, with very few shops on the way.

Renting a car: bring your passport, your home driving licence and an International Driving Permit (IDP), plus a credit card in the driver's name. Most companies require age 21+ and at least 1 year of driving experience.
Where to rent: counters at Incheon/Gimpo airports and major KTX stations (e.g. Cheonan-Asan, about 1 h 30 min to Taean), or book in a rental app in advance.
Navigation: enter "만대항" (Mandae Port) in Naver Map or KakaoMap. Expressway tolls are paid by Hi-pass in the car or at the booth; speed cameras are common.
The course is one-way: park at Mandae Port and take a taxi back from Kkujinamugol Beach (about 15 min) – save a local taxi number before you start.
Start by 10:00, wear hiking shoes, and carry water and a packed lunch. Check the tide times – some beach sections are easier at low tide.
